grantRole(bytes4,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

grantRoles(bytes4[],address).details: Grants all of `role` in `roles` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - For each `role` in `roles`, the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

init(address).details: This is the exact same as mint() but with auth added and skip the supply > 0 check and checks instead that supply == 0. This intialize mechanism is different than UniV2.  Tokens addresses are added at contract creation. This pool is considered initialized after the first LP token is minted.

renounceRole(bytes4,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`.

revokeRoles(bytes4[],address).details: Revokes all of `role` in `roles` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - For each `role` in `roles`, the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

AfterMaturity().notice: The pool has matured and maybe you should too.

FYTokenCachedBadState().notice: The update would cause the FYToken cached to be less than the total supply. This should never happen but may occur due to unexpected rounding errors.  We cannot allow this to happen as it could have many unexpected and side effects which may pierce the fabric of the space-time continuum.

Initialized().notice: The pool has already been initialized. What are you thinking?

InvalidFee(uint16).notice: Represents the fee in bps, and it cannot be larger than 10,000.

MaturityOverflow().notice: The year is 2106 and an invalid maturity date was passed into the constructor. Maturity date must be less than type(uint32).max

MuCannotBeZero().notice: Mu cannot be zero. And you're not a hero.

NegativeInterestRatesNotAllowed(uint128,.notice: Trade results in negative interest rates because fyToken balance < (newSharesBalance * mu). Don't neg me.

NotEnoughBaseIn(uint256,uint256).notice: Not enough base was found in the pool contract to complete the requested action. You just wasted gas.

NotEnoughFYTokenIn(uint256,uint256).notice: Not enough fYTokens were found in the pool contract to complete the requested action :( smh.

NotInitialized().notice: The pool has not been initialized yet. INTRUDER ALERT!

SlippageDuringBurn(uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: The reserves have changed compared with the last cache which causes the burn to fall outside the bounds of min/max slippage ratios selected. This is likely the result of a peanut butter sandwich attack.

SlippageDuringMint(uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: The reserves have changed compared with the last cache which causes the mint to fall outside the bounds of min/max slippage ratios selected. This is likely the result of a bologna sandwich attack.

SlippageDuringSellBase(uint128,uint128).notice: Minimum amount of fyToken (per the min arg) would not be met for the trade. Try again.

SlippageDuringSellFYToken(uint128,uint12.notice: Minimum amount of base (per the min arg) would not be met for the trade. Maybe you'll get lucky next time.

Liquidity(uint32,address,address,address.notice: A liquidity event has occured (burn / mint).

Sync(uint112,uint112,uint256).notice: The _update fn has run and cached balances updated.

Trade(uint32,address,address,int256,int2.notice: One of the four trading functions has been called: - buyBase - sellBase - buyFYToken - sellFYToken

gg().notice: Pool is matured and all LP tokens burned. gg.

baseDecimals().notice: Decimals of base tokens (fyToken, lp token, and usually the sharesToken).

baseToken().notice: This pool accepts a pair of base and fyToken tokens. When these are deposited into a tokenized vault they become shares. It is an ERC20 token.

burn(address,address,uint256,uint256).notice: Burn liquidity tokens in exchange for base and fyToken. The liquidity tokens need to be previously tranfsferred to this contract.

burnForBase(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Burn liquidity tokens in exchange for base. The liquidity provider needs to have called `pool.approve`. Only usable before maturity.

buyBase(address,uint128,uint128).notice: Buy base with fyToken. The trader needs to have transferred in the necessary amount of fyTokens in advance.

buyBasePreview(uint128).notice: Returns how much fyToken would be required to buy `baseOut` base.

buyFYToken(address,uint128,uint128).notice: Buy fyToken with base. The trader needs to have transferred in the correct amount of base tokens in advance.

buyFYTokenPreview(uint128).notice: Returns how much base would be required to buy `fyTokenOut`.

cumulativeRatioLast().notice: This is a LAGGING, time weighted sum of the fyToken:shares reserves ratio measured in ratio seconds.

currentCumulativeRatio().notice: Calculates cumulative ratio as of current timestamp.  Can be consumed for TWAR observations.

fyToken().notice: The fyToken for the corresponding base token. Ex. yvDAI's fyToken will be fyDAI. Even though we convert base in this contract to a wrapped tokenized vault (e.g. Yearn Vault Dai), the fyToken is still payable in the base token upon maturity.

g1().notice: Exposes the 64.64 factor used for determining fees. A value of 1 (in 64.64) means no fees.  g1 < 1 because it is used when selling base shares to the pool.

g1Fee().notice: This number is used to calculate the fees for buying/selling fyTokens.

g2().notice: Exposes the 64.64 factor used for determining fees. A value of 1 means no fees.  g2 > 1 because it is used when selling fyToken to the pool.

getC().notice: Returns current price of 1 share in 64bit. Useful for external contracts that need to perform calculations related to pool.

getCache().notice: Returns the all storage vars except for cumulativeRatioLast

getCurrentSharePrice().notice: Returns the base token current price.

getFYTokenBalance().notice: The "virtual" fyToken balance, which is the actual balance plus the pool token supply.

getSharesBalance().notice: Returns the shares balance with the same decimals as the underlying base asset.

invariant().notice: Returns the result of the total supply invariant function

maxBaseIn().notice: Returns the max amount of Base that can be sold to the pool

maxBaseOut().notice: Returns the max amount of Base that can be bought from the pool

maxFYTokenIn().notice: Returns the max amount of FYTokens that can be sold to the pool

maxFYTokenOut().notice: Returns the max amount of FYTokens that can be bought from the pool

mint(address,address,uint256,uint256).notice: Mint liquidity tokens in exchange for adding base and fyToken The amount of liquidity tokens to mint is calculated from the amount of unaccounted for fyToken in this contract. A proportional amount of asset tokens need to be present in this contract, also unaccounted for.

mintWithBase(address,address,uint256,uin.notice: Mint liquidity tokens in exchange for adding only base. The amount of liquidity tokens is calculated from the amount of fyToken to buy from the pool. The base tokens need to be previously transferred and present in this contract.

mu().notice: The normalization coefficient, the initial c value or price per 1 share of base (64.64)

retrieveBase(address).notice: Retrieve any shares/base tokens not accounted for in the cache. Note: For PoolNonTv, sharesToken == baseToken. This fn is the same as retrieveShares().

retrieveFYToken(address).notice: Retrieve any fyTokens not accounted for in the cache.

retrieveShares(address).notice: Retrieve any shares/base tokens not accounted for in the cache. Note: For PoolNonTv, sharesToken == baseToken. This fn is the same as retrieveBase().

scaleFactor().notice: Used to scale up to 18 decimals (not 64.64)

sellBase(address,uint128).notice: Sell base for fyToken. The trader needs to have transferred the amount of base to sell to the pool before calling this fn.

sellBasePreview(uint128).notice: Returns how much fyToken would be obtained by selling `baseIn`.

sellFYToken(address,uint128).notice: Sell fyToken for base. The trader needs to have transferred the amount of fyToken to sell to the pool before in the same transaction.

sellFYTokenPreview(uint128).notice: Returns how much base would be obtained by selling `fyTokenIn` fyToken.

setFees(uint16).notice: Sets g1 as an fp4, g1 <= 1.0

sharesToken().notice: When base comes into this contract it is deposited into a 3rd party tokenized vault in return for shares.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: if_succeeds {:msg "TransferFrom - decrease allowance"} msg.sender != src ==> old(_allowance[src][msg.sender]) >= wad;

ts().notice: Time stretch == 1 / seconds in x years where x varies per contract (64.64)

unwrap(address).notice: Unwraps base shares found unaccounted for in this contract, converting them to the base assets.

unwrapPreview(uint256).notice: Preview how many asset tokens will be received when unwrapping a given amount of shares.

wrap(address).notice: Wraps any base asset tokens found in the contract, converting them to base tokenized vault shares.

wrapPreview(uint256).notice: Preview how many shares will be received when depositing a given amount of base.

userdoc.notice: Module for using non tokenized vault tokens as "shares" for the Yield Protocol Pool.sol AMM contract. For example ordinary DAI, as opposed to yvDAI or eDAI.
